name: build_call_path
description: Build every shortest direct-callee path from complete analyze_function Evidence supplied inline or by exact retained-evidence references. References reuse the complete parent of an analyze_function summary without resending dossiers. Uses exact canonical addresses; missing dossiers and provider mixing remain unknown, and every node and edge cites source Evidence.
